global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender noodles, topped with vibrant green scallions and a dark nori sheet. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns and subtle reflections under warm ambient lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue geometric pattern and Japanese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, with visible noodles, green onions, and a dark topping, showing surface bubbles.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green-brown, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface.
